name: Protect Ceiling Fixtures & Verify Window Masking
intent: Cover ceiling-mounted fixtures (light cans, fans, smoke detectors) and verify that window openings are masked before any spray application. Walks each window opening to confirm tape coverage. Roll scenarios skip this module entirely — drips don't reach ceiling fixtures or windows.
doctrine: Ceiling fixture protection (4 rooms/hr = 15 minutes per room) accounts for ~4 fixtures per typical ceiling: light fixture, smoke detector, ceiling fan or vent, plus tape on the wall edge masking already in place. Window verification rate (20 windows/hr = 3 minutes per window) is a walk-and-check, not a re-mask. The module is included by spray and spray_backroll scenarios only.
